Agentic workloads, long documents, and large codebases are pushing context lengths from tens of thousands of tokens to hundreds of thousands. At those lengths, attention becomes the most expensive part of a transformer layer. items.title: Integrating QPUs into Supercomputing Centers Using Slurm HRES Plugins
items.opening: Quantum processors are being integrated into supercomputing centers worldwide. National programs in North America, Europe, and Asia are driving the installation... Quantum processors are being integrated into supercomputing centers worldwide. National programs in North America, Europe, and Asia are driving the installation of quantum processing units (QPUs) alongside high-performance computing (HPC) systems. Every supercomputer will eventually be a hybrid quantum-classical device, drawing on quantum processors to expand what’s possible in scientific research. Source
